name: Kirihara Touko
source:
Touko is a descendant from a samurai clan. [spoiler]She used to go out with [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url].[/spoiler] Currently, she is very harsh to him. "Kirihara" is an anagram of Harakiri, which Taichi sometimes uses as her nickname. She scored 44% on the adaptation exam, and as Taichi says at one point, is "desperately trying to hold on to the last 56% of her humanity as best she can."

[Edited from [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Cross_Channel_%28visual_novel%29]Wikipedia[/url]]
